requirements.name: Integrated lifecycle product
requirements.product_principle: Plugin, CLI, Harness-owned tools, and lifecycle are one product and one dependency graph.
requirements.product_proof: Independent acquisition-through-completion journey suite.
requirements.completion_blocker: Any applicable lifecycle journey is absent, stale, bypassed, or below its required ceiling.

requirements.name: Progressive plugin closure
requirements.product_principle: A concise front door progressively routes to complete product-owned journeys.
requirements.validator: planned: component reachability, context budget, ambiguity, and journey closure validator
requirements.product_proof: Application discovery and representative skill journey replay.
requirements.completion_blocker: The intended plugin entry or a required routed journey is not behaviorally discoverable.

requirements.name: Surface-specific discovery truth
requirements.product_principle: Source, package, install, cache, application, and runtime truth are distinct and reconciled transitions.
requirements.product_proof: Independent proof ladder from package bytes through new-task runtime.
requirements.completion_blocker: Evidence from one surface is used to claim another or an identity transition is unreconciled.

requirements.name: Reconciled setup and retrofit
requirements.product_principle: Inspect, plan, explicitly apply, preserve, and verify repository fitting.
fixtures: planned: existing AGENTS and local edits
requirements.product_proof: Before/after preservation plus host load and representative routine workflow.
requirements.completion_blocker: User-owned decisions are changed, duplicate authority remains, or loaded behavior is unreconciled.

requirements.name: Immutable current-input snapshot
requirements.product_principle: All authority-bearing work consumes one immutable, congruent current-input identity.
requirements.product_proof: Independent input enumeration and deterministic identity/invalidation comparison.
requirements.completion_blocker: Relevant inputs are unknown, mutable during proof, or evidence lacks a congruent context.

requirements.name: Verified incremental legality
requirements.product_principle: Routine speed comes from a proven dependency closure and verified node reuse.
requirements.product_proof: Incremental versus strict no-cache mutation corpus.
requirements.completion_blocker: Affected closure or reused node cannot be independently shown equivalent for the current candidate.

requirements.name: Single typed authority graph
requirements.product_principle: One semantic graph owns findings, repair, state, next, and claims; commands are views.
requirements.product_proof: All equivalent selectors return the same state and ceiling from one context.
requirements.completion_blocker: Two active surfaces can independently compute or contradict the same readiness/completion decision.

requirements.name: Independent claim reconciliation
requirements.product_principle: Evidence is observation until a congruent, independent path reconciles the claimed behavior.
requirements.product_proof: Independent reconciler for each CL-* claim.
requirements.completion_blocker: A completion-bearing item validates itself or lacks false-pass/stale/wrong-surface rejection.

requirements.name: Routine and strict coverage intelligence
requirements.product_principle: Routine guidance and strict whole-surface coverage are distinct, explicit scopes.
requirements.product_proof: No-cache strict run and known behavior mutations.
requirements.completion_blocker: Coverage scope, profile identity, exclusions, or semantic mapping is unverifiable.

requirements.name: Queryable semantic observability
requirements.product_principle: A zero-dependency local semantic plane supports repair; optional export is separately reconciled.
requirements.product_proof: Known-operation local and, when required, backend roundtrip query.
requirements.completion_blocker: The required plane cannot query current correlated privacy-safe events or is substituted by another plane.

requirements.name: Exact repair and next action
requirements.product_principle: Every blocker closes with one smallest safe repair, exact rerun, effect, and ceiling.
requirements.product_proof: Deterministic selection plus operator comprehension and successful known-fault recovery.
requirements.completion_blocker: A blocker lacks a safe exact repair/rerun or competing next-action authorities disagree.

requirements.name: Goal lineage without simulation
requirements.product_principle: Use platform durable goal state when available and keep repository work lineage distinct.
requirements.product_proof: Observed platform goal state joined to, but not inferred from, repository work state.
requirements.completion_blocker: Repository artifacts simulate or contradict required platform goal authority.

requirements.name: Adaptive Ultra work graph
requirements.product_principle: The root derives product-semantic packages and dependencies from current state.
requirements.product_proof: Adversarial graph scenarios reconstructed by a non-authoring reviewer.
requirements.completion_blocker: Plan depends on a fixed historical lane list or current dependencies/authority are not represented.

requirements.name: Typed worker ownership and acceptance
requirements.product_principle: Workers have bounded disjoint ownership; root independently accepts and reconciles.
requirements.product_proof: Scenario suite plus root restart reconstruction.
requirements.completion_blocker: Worker ownership is ambiguous, output is unreconciled, or worker assertion raises authority.

requirements.name: Independent falsification
requirements.product_principle: Material claims face a non-authoring attempt to falsify product behavior and evidence.
requirements.validator: planned: review independence and evidence-reproduction validator
fixtures: planned: discovered false pass re-enters graph
requirements.product_proof: Independent reviewer reproduces critical evidence and executes false-pass prompts.
requirements.completion_blocker: Required review is non-independent, advisory-only, stale, or leaves material findings unresolved.

requirements.name: Confinement, permission, and secret safety
requirements.product_principle: Every effect is bounded by explicit authority, safe paths, least privilege, and redaction.
requirements.validator: planned: security authority and confinement suite
requirements.product_proof: Adversarial filesystem, process, secret, telemetry, and external-state exercises.
requirements.completion_blocker: An effect, path, secret, privilege, or external boundary is ambiguous or bypassable.

requirements.name: Reproducible package integrity
requirements.product_principle: Reconcile source and build inputs through package, install, and application identity.
requirements.product_proof: Independent build/extract/install comparison with optional release signature verification.
requirements.completion_blocker: Package origin, inputs, bytes, or installed identity is unreconciled.

requirements.name: Discoverable, typed, non-surprising CLI
requirements.product_principle: Use domain types, conventional help/output/exit behavior, and structural effect separation.
requirements.product_proof: Black-box CLI journey and filesystem/external-state before/after comparison.
requirements.completion_blocker: A read command mutates, a domain input is weakly typed, or duplicate command authority remains.

requirements.name: Valid evaluations and failure harvesting
requirements.product_principle: Evaluation data and scoring must be valid before they can block or promote product changes.
requirements.product_proof: Independent baseline/candidate replay on audited tasks with negative controls.
requirements.completion_blocker: An authority-bearing eval has invalid, ambiguous, contaminated, or irreproducible data/scoring.

requirements.name: Evidence-driven improvement loop
requirements.product_principle: Reconciled failure flows through hypothesis, valid eval, review, promotion, and rollback.
requirements.product_proof: Before/after valid evaluation plus independent review and real-surface reconciliation.
requirements.completion_blocker: Improvement is self-certified, anecdotal, wrong-surface, regressive, or lacks rollback.

requirements.name: Fast routine work, honest strict proof
requirements.product_principle: Routine work is affected-set fast; strict proof exposes real scope and verified reuse.
requirements.validator: planned: performance scope and measurement validator
fixtures: planned: dirty tree and missing optional service
requirements.product_proof: Repeated representative repository-tier measurements with executed/reused work accounting.
requirements.completion_blocker: A speed claim lacks executed or verified-reuse scope, environment, distribution, or honest critical path.

requirements.name: Telemetry minimization and retention
requirements.product_principle: Collect only product-required data, classify/redact it before persistence/export, and bound retention/cardinality.
requirements.product_proof: Inspect local and exported events under injected sensitive/high-cardinality inputs and verify deterministic deletion.
requirements.completion_blocker: Sensitive, unclassified, unbounded, over-retained, or undeletable data is persisted or exported.

requirements.name: Measured entropy and retirement
requirements.product_principle: Inventory and safely retire obsolete authority, drift, and cache only after replacement proof.
requirements.validator: planned: maintenance plan and residual-authority validator
fixtures: planned: cache growth and scoped cleanup
requirements.product_proof: Upgrade/rollback and cleanup journeys plus package/app/runtime absence of retired surfaces.
requirements.completion_blocker: Obsolete duplicate authority remains active or cleanup lacks authorization/replacement/verification.

requirements.name: Honest stop and completion ceiling
requirements.product_principle: Only root authority issues the minimum current independently reconciled integrated ceiling.
requirements.product_proof: Root reproduction plus non-authoring integrated falsification and required real-use journeys.
requirements.completion_blocker: Any applicable required claim is unknown, blocked, stale, invalid, unreconciled, or below the requested ceiling.
